verdict.rationale: Tavily is an API-first product with a documented public API reference covering Search, Extract, Crawl, Map, Research (including async status retrieval and streaming), Usage and Logs endpoints. It also documents rate limits with 429/retry-after semantics and ships official Python and JS SDKs, and a community user reports having agents drive it programmatically. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of common paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Execute a search query using Tavily Search.
Extract content from one URL or batch up to 20 URLs in one request. Successful URLs appear in results; per-URL failures appear in failed_results.
Retrieve the status and results of a research task using its request ID.
the API returns a `429 Too Many Requests` response with a `retry-after` header indicating the number of seconds to wait before making another request
or call the API directly with a free API key.
The Python SDK allows for easy interaction with the Tavily API, offering the full range of our search functionality directly from your Python programs.
